review.en: Recorded in New York by the Ethiopian vibraphonist, arranger and composer Mulatu Astatke, this short album sets Ethiopian modal scales over jazz and Latin rhythms, the blend he called Ethio-jazz. It reached few people at first. Through the Éthiopiques reissue series and Jim Jarmusch's film Broken Flowers his music later found a wide audience, and this record became a reference point for the style.
review.zh: 埃塞俄比亚颤音琴手、编曲家和作曲家穆拉图·阿斯塔特克在纽约录制的一张短专辑，把埃塞俄比亚的调式音阶放在爵士和拉丁节奏之上，他称之为埃塞俄比亚爵士。起初知道的人很少。后来经由《Éthiopiques》再版系列和贾木许的电影《破碎之花》，他的音乐找到大批听众，这张唱片也成了这种风格的参照点。
